Patton · app icon

Ten icons for Patton

Ten directions for a sleeker icon that keeps the reference to the general: his helmet, his three stars, his name, and the tank named after him. Each sits on the rounded tile that current Mac apps use, shown full size and at 64, 32 and 16 pixels, three of the sizes Patton's icon file carries.

Round 6 · The face made of falling digits

You said the face should be made of the falling numbers, not sit behind them. Here the same falling streams cover the whole tile and simply brighten where they pass through the face. P2, the one you liked, comes first in the Docks below.

F1Face in the rain

Every digit is part of a falling stream; the streams brighten where they pass through the face.

F2Subtler

The same streams, the face a step fainter.

F3Subtlest

Mostly falling rain, the face just drawn out of it.

Round 5 · More background, fainter face

You asked for P2's direction, further: more of the falling green, the portrait more subtle. Each step goes past P2. P1, as installed now, and P2 come first in the Docks below.

R1More background

A step past P2: the falling digits stronger, the portrait fainter.

R2Mostly background

Further again: the rain fills the tile and the portrait sits inside it.

R3Ghost portrait

The furthest: a busy wall of falling digits with the portrait just showing through.

Round 4 · The portrait in falling digits

You said A2 still looks like a bowler hat. This round goes back to the original portrait and draws it in digits, like N1 but quieter, so more of the falling numbers behind it show.

P1Portrait in green

The original portrait drawn in bright digits, with falling digits behind it across the whole tile.

P2Quieter portrait

P1 with the portrait dimmer and the falling digits stronger.

P3Portrait in amber

P1 in amber, the colour of Patton's typing box.

Round 3 · Falling numbers

Your A2 helmet, now in the app, drawn from falling digits with the three stars showing faintly. Each is beside A2 in the Docks below.

N1Green rain

Falling digits across the whole tile, packed bright inside the helmet; the stars are dark cut-outs.

N2Helmet only

The digits fall only inside the helmet, on plain black.

N3Amber rain

N1 in amber, the colour of Patton's typing box and the brass stars.

N4A2 in digits

Your A2 as it is, with faint falling digits worked into the helmet's surface.

Round 2 · A, less curved

You picked A and said the helmet shouldn't be too curved. Here are four flatter versions beside the first: a flatter brim, a flatter crown, both, and a straight brim.

A1As first drawn

The rim sweeps well down at the sides, under a round crown.

A2Flatter brim

The same crown; the rim drops half as far at the sides.

A3Flatter crown

A lower, broader top with steeper sides; the first rim.

A4Both flatter

The lower crown on the flatter brim.

A5Straight brim

A flat-topped crown on a straight brim, the most geometric.

Before

A fine-line pen portrait on a plain white square, which macOS 26 clips into its rounded tile. Its thin lines fade at small sizes.

AHelmet

The old icon's helmet and three stars, without the face.

Keeps the helmet, the three stars

BSilhouette

The general in profile as one solid shape, like the head on a medal.

Keeps the portrait, the helmet, the stars

CUnder the brim

The helmet drawn as a single line, with a terminal prompt where the face was.

Keeps the helmet, the stars, the terminal

DStar cursor

A terminal prompt whose cursor is a general's star.

Keeps a star, the terminal

EWindow stars

A terminal window whose three window buttons are the three stars.

Keeps the three stars, the terminal

FThree stars

Only the rank: three stars in brass on olive drab. The clearest at small sizes.

Keeps the three stars

GStencil star

The white star in a ring painted on American tanks in the Second World War, with stencil breaks in the ring.

Keeps his army's marking

HStencil P

A stencilled P, like the lettering on army crates, with the three stars beneath.

Keeps the name, the three stars

IDog tag

A steel identity tag stamped with the name, the stars and a prompt.

Keeps the name, the stars, the terminal

JPatton tank

The M48 Patton tank, named after him, side on with its white star.

Keeps the name, his army's marking

In the Dock

All ten at Dock size beside the icon before, on a light and a dark desktop.
